**Tier 6.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `account`, `activity`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `customers`, `delivery`, `identity`, `invoicing`, `messaging`, `payments`, `plugins`, `settings`, `shipping`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `identity`, `messaging`, `settings`.

Feature map entry: `chat` in [docs/features.json](../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm run feature -- chat` for its full span.

## Routes

- `GET /account/chat/sessions`
- `POST /account/chat/sessions`
- `GET /account/chat/sessions/:publicId`
- `GET /account/chat/sessions/:publicId/attachments/:attachmentId`
- `POST /account/chat/sessions/:publicId/close`
- `GET /account/chat/sessions/:publicId/events`
- `POST /account/chat/sessions/:publicId/messages`
- `POST /account/chat/sessions/:publicId/presence`
- `POST /account/chat/sessions/:publicId/read`
